units.source_text: “总归一句话，叔叔骗取了我的财产。

en.t: In short, my uncle swindled me out of my property.

units.source_text: 他在我去东京的三年间，轻而易举就做到了。

en.t: He accomplished it easily during the three years I was away in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 我漫不经心地把一切都委托给叔叔打理，从世俗的角度看，我简直是个大傻瓜。

en.t: From a worldly point of view, I was a complete fool for carelessly entrusting everything to my uncle.

units.source_text: 但是，若从脱离世俗的层面来说，或许也可以说，我是个纯洁可敬的人吧。

en.t: But if one looks at it from a plane removed from worldly concerns, perhaps one could also say that I was a pure and admirable person.

units.source_text: 每每回顾过去，我便为自己过分憨直的天性而懊悔不已，自己为什么没有脱胎为坏人？

en.t: Whenever I look back, I bitterly regret my overly honest nature and wonder why I did not transform myself into a bad person.

units.source_text: 同时也想过，要是能够回到刚出生的纯洁无瑕之时，重新活一次该多好啊！

en.t: At the same time, I also thought how wonderful it would be if I could return to the pure, unblemished state of my birth and live my life over again.

units.source_text: 请你记住，你所认识的我，是已经被红尘污染了的我。

en.t: Please remember that the me you know is the me who has already been stained by the dust of the world.

units.source_text: 如果把几经污染的长辈称为前辈的话，我的确可以算是你的前辈吧。

en.t: If elders who have been stained again and again are called seniors, then I can indeed be considered your senior.
